title: JAH GlidePoint Air
description: The JAH GlidePoint Air is a Signature concept mouse with a levitating shell that hovers on an air bearing for zero friction. Simulated 4000 Hz polling and 48,000 DPI explore the ceiling of tracking fidelity. Signature concept only — not a manufactured product.

demo.program:
# JAH GlidePoint Air: polling latency + physical travel math
dpi_max = 48000
polling_hz = 4000
latency_ms = 1000 / polling_hz
counts_per_mm = dpi_max / 25.4
print(f"Poll interval at {polling_hz} Hz: {latency_ms:.2f} ms")
print(f"Counts per mm of travel: {counts_per_mm:.0f}")
# physical travel to cross a 3440 px ultrawide at 800 DPI with 2x OS multiplier
px = 3440; eff_dpi = 800 * 2
mm = px / eff_dpi * 25.4
print(f"Travel to cross 3440 px @ 800 DPI x2: {mm:.1f} mm")

provenance: Signature-authored original created by the JAH system. This is original Signature work, clearly labeled as such — not a public record and not a real product.
